```{r}
library(tidyverse)

read_aact = function(table) {
  read_delim(
    file.path("raw_data", paste0(table, ".txt")),
    delim = "|",
    col_types = cols(.default = "c")
  )
}

# Studies: interventional trials starting 2015–2025
studies = read_aact("studies")

keep_ids = pull(studies, nct_id)

# Other tables, restricted to those trials
tables = c("countries", "sponsors", "conditions", "browse_conditions")

aact = tables |>
  set_names() |>
  map(\(t) read_aact(t) |> filter(nct_id %in% keep_ids))

# Save as .rds
write_rds(studies, file.path("data", "studies.rds"), compress = "xz")
iwalk(aact, \(df, name) write_rds(df, file.path("data", paste0(name, ".rds")), compress = "xz"))

# Sizes in MB; anything over ~50 should be gitignored
file.size(list.files("data", full.names = TRUE)) / 1e6
```
